recovery_decisions.reason: ambiguous mutation must be reconciled and never blindly replayed

claim_boundary: Synthetic protocol interoperability gate only; not a coding benchmark or software-engineering capability score.

diagnosis.classification: DeepSeek interoperated reliably with the function-call channel and completed 9 of 12 frozen protocols, but missed three exact required sequencing/tool-coverage milestones; the frozen 80% admission threshold therefore yields NOT COMPATIBLE.
observed_evidence: All 11 tool-required cases began with a valid API tool call and no plan response preceded the first tool call.
All 47 model actions were structurally valid; malformed, unknown-tool, and invalid-argument rates were zero.
sequence-locate-read-patch used search_code instead of the frozen required list_files milestone, then read, patched, tested successfully, and stopped.

sequence-test-repair read the implementation before running the required initial failing test, so it repaired the code and passed both tests but violated the frozen failed-test -> read -> patch -> passed-test order.
state-diff-awareness searched, patched, inspected git_diff, and finalized without the frozen required read_file call.
No case timed out, looped on plans, made a duplicate mutation, retried unsafely, or finalized prematurely.
All 144 sandbox assertions, 12 contamination gates, and 12 trace/run reconciliations passed; there were no infrastructure failures or unclassified structured errors.

known_limitations: Twelve synthetic cases measure protocol interoperability, not coding ability.
One repetition does not measure variance.
Prelude and fault evidence are deterministic fixtures, not naturally model-generated errors.
